Downloaded 2026-08-25 (PR #84) to ignored data_lock/raw directory; real xlsx (Microsoft Excel 2007+), integrity confirmed by successful full parse (2,176 data rows, one sheet "Data_Set_3_Proteins_mIHC", 8 columns: PDO_id, Prot_marker, mIHC_stain_no, AB_order, Fluor, mean_express_PDO, area_pixels, Slide). Fourteen protein markers total (ABCB1/ABCG2/CDH1/CDX2/CFTR/ERBB2/HSF1/KI67/KRT20/KRT7/RCC2/RIPK1/TP53/UGT1A) -- only ERBB2 is among this repository's five A_CLINICAL targets. Per the source publication's own methods text (PMC13293968, independently fetched and confirmed 2026-08-25): "Fluorescence-based multiplex immunohistochemistry and digital image analyses were used to analyze in situ expression of fourteen proteins in 136 PDOs and two corresponding tumor tissue samples from 67 patients." *** ERBB2-specific caveat, not a formality: the same methods text states verbatim, "KRT7 and ERBB2 were excluded from analysis due to no or very low expression levels, respectively." The 136 raw per-PDO ERBB2 values are present in this file and are what scripts/extract_pdo_erbb2_mihc.py reads, but the source authors' own QC judged this marker unreliable in this 14-plex panel and excluded it from their published analysis -- this caveat must accompany any use of this data as evidence, never presented as clean corroboration without it.
